problem_statement: Fix parse_roman() so it returns the integer represented by a canonical uppercase Roman numeral from I through MMMCMXCIX (1 through 3999). Canonical forms use only I, V, X, L, C, D, and M with the standard IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, and CM subtractive pairs. Return None for empty, lowercase, unknown, or noncanonical text, including illegal repetition and subtraction.
